summary: The original leak was independently reproduced on the prepared base in the Responses, chat-completion, and completion conversion/streaming paths. At the exact candidate commit, the focused regressions, the complete four-file endpoint suite, request-isolation and tool-preservation cases, and independent split-delimiter/echo streaming cases pass. The patch changes no native source and imports resolve to the checked-out Python tree. Live HTTP inference was not run because the prepared environment has no model weights.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction on base: all 6 cases failed, demonstrating reasoning leakage in chat non-stream/stream, completion non-stream/stream, Responses non-stream/stream, including request isolation and tool-call preservation expectations.
Exact candidate: 204 passed and 72 subtests passed across actual endpoint response builders and stream converters.

remaining_limitations: No live model server or HTTP curl reproduction was run because the prepared environment contains no model weights.

The review validates the real Python request schemas, response builders, reasoning/tool parsers, and streaming converters with synthetic engine output; it does not validate model-specific generation quality.
No native source changed, repository-environment.json reports native=null, and therefore no native rebuild was applicable.
